name: Thai satay noodle stir-fry
title: Satay stir-fry

steps.text: Mix peanut butter, sweet chilli, soy and 100ml water into a smooth satay sauce.
Noodles in a bowl, cover with boiling water, separate, drain well.
Hot wok, oil; stir-fry the ginger and the harder veg for 2 min.
Noodles and the rest of the veg in; high heat 1-2 min.
Push to one side, pour sauce in the other side, bring to the boil, mix through.
Basil and chopped peanuts on top; serve.

equipment: a jug or bowl for the sauce
